messages:
Maya Chen: quick pulse — vendor says they can lock 8 A100s for uswest2 08/03-08/07 but need a PO by EOD tomorrow. link: https://vendor.example/po/12345
Oliver Park: Is that 8 GPUs dedicated or shared with other tenants?
Vendor Portal: Those are reserved for your account (standby pool) but not yet billed until PO is accepted.
Sam R.: Maya can you paste the expected qps/throughput? we should check batch config
Maya Chen: workload is model-sweep for performance demos: ~60 rps peak, want to keep p99 < 250ms. We'll run batching target 8-12.
Lee Nguyen: 8 A100s sounds tight. For the sweep I expect we'll need ephemeral burst to 12 during canaries.
Maya Chen: noted. @Finance Bot can you confirm we can sign the PO? cost is $12,400 for the window
Finance Bot: Budget ok for Q3 demo line item DEV-DEMO-23. Need internal PO number before vendor accepts.
Oliver Park: If finance ok, I'll open PO and ping procurement. What's the PO format? any fields?
Vendor Portal: PO should include: vendor id 7890, start/end dates, cc: billing@vendor, account alias redwood-inference-prod
Sam R.: Also pinging @Lee Nguyen — can we patch the autoscaler to allow short-lived +4 GPUs during the 2-hour canaries? simple boolean flag in infra-config
Lee Nguyen: yes, I can enable a burst-capacity flag in the pool: set `max_burst=12` and `burst_ttl=2h`. I'll submit a PR now.
Maya Chen: thx. I'll hold off sign until PO number in hand. Oliver, assign me the PR for FYI.
Oliver Park: assigning to @Maya Chen. PR: https://git.internal/infra/PR-4921
Vendor Portal: vendor portal updated: quote expires 18h from now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam R.: small devex ask — can someone drop a smoke-test checklist for A100s? quick items: gpu driver, CUDA 11.8, NCCL, kernel patch
Lee Nguyen: adding checklist stub in #eng-infra-smoke: https://wiki.internal/smoke/a100
Maya Chen: thanks. if procurement moves fast we should be green by tomorrow. :rocket:
Oliver Park: I'll follow up in the morning and update thread. :thumbsup:
